研究采用简化半固态挤出法制备了丙丙醇、螺内酯和泼尼松龙的个性化儿童片剂，经质量控: A simplified semi-solid extrusion method produced personalized pediatric tablets containing propranolol, spironolactone or prednisolone. Quality control showed uniform mass and stability, and dissolution met USP criteria. Drug losses after administration through a nasogastric tube ranged from 4% to 36%.
